title: 字节整合AI办公产品，TRAE、扣子团队并入豆包
content:
On August 24, according to media reports, ByteDance has completed the team integration of its AI office products. The TRAE and Coze (Coze) teams will be fully integrated into the Doubao system. Among them, TRAE Work and Coze will integrate their product capabilities for work scenarios with Doubao; TRAE IDE and CLI will continue to develop as the programming product line under the Doubao brand. After the adjustment, the relevant products and operations teams will report to Zhao Qi, the product leader of Doubao. (iFeng Tech)
TRA and Coze were previously under ByteDance's Product Development and Engineering Architecture Department. The former was initially positioned as an AI programming product, while the latter focused on the AI intelligent agent development platform and continuously explored different Agent directions. This integration further clarifies Doubao's core business positioning in AI, concentrating AI office product resources on Doubao. ByteDance responded that the adjustment aims to coordinate product and technical resources to provide users with a better AI work experience, and existing user rights will not be affected. (Sina)
It is reported that Doubao will launch its independent AI office product "Doubao Work" as early as this week, serving as a unified product and brand for ByteDance's AI office scenarios. Recently, Doubao has been frequently updating features such as remote control of computers, Windows virtual desktops, cloud computers, and side workbenches, and has launched more than 200 skills and connectors. (iFeng Tech)
This adjustment means that ByteDance is further consolidating its AI office product line and strengthening Doubao's core entry point status in AI productivity scenarios by unifying the brand and Agent capabilities. With companies like Tencent and Alibaba continuing to invest heavily in AI office, the competition in the domestic AI office market is accelerating from single-point tools to unified Agent platforms.

report.summary: 字节跳动整合AI办公产品，TRAE与扣子团队并入豆包，强化AI办公统一入口。
report.background: 字节跳动此前在AI办公领域布局分散：TRAE主打AI编程，扣子（Coze）聚焦智能体开发平台，两者均隶属产品研发与工程架构部。随着国内AI办公竞争加剧，腾讯、阿里等竞品持续加码，字节决定将资源集中到豆包体系，以统一品牌和Agent能力应对市场变化。此次整合后，豆包将推出独立办公产品“豆包工作”，进一步巩固其作为字节AI生产力场景核心入口的地位，现有用户权益不受影响。
key_points: TRAE和扣子团队整体并入豆包，TRAE工作版与扣子的办公场景能力将融合进豆包，IDE和CLI则作为豆包旗下编程产品线继续发展。
调整后相关产品和运营团队将汇报给豆包产品负责人赵琪，组织架构上明确豆包在AI办公领域的统一指挥权。
豆包近期密集上线电脑远程控制、Windows虚拟桌面、云电脑、侧边工作台等功能，并已推出超200个技能和连接器，为独立办公产品蓄力。
字节回应称此次调整是为了协同产品与技术资源，提供更好的AI工作体验，同时强调不影响用户现有权益。
国内AI办公市场正从单一工具竞争转向统一Agent平台竞争，字节整合是这一趋势下的主动卡位。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，字节将编程和智能体能力统一收归豆包，意味着大厂AI办公竞争进入平台化阶段，单点工具将更难独立生存。对开发者，TRAE IDE和CLI保留独立发展，编程场景仍有机会，但需适应豆包生态和可能的接口调整。对普通用户，豆包办公产品功能更集中，未来可能获得更连贯的AI工作流体验，但也要留意付费模式兼容性。
report.tools: 建议关注豆包（Doubao）最新办公版本及其技能/连接器市场；开发者可跟进TRAE IDE/CLI更新；智能体开发者可研究扣子（Coze）平台如何与豆包工作场景联动。官方社区和API文档是上手首选渠道。
